# Inactive Mushy Room movement

The unchanged Mushy Room attachment affects both teams. A cardless original
MageT1_Junker moves across its boundary while moon tracking stays off. Six
native Bumps cover Full entry/exit, stale Full-to-New understanding on entry
and exit (mask 6 to 5), and the aligned New return. Its original marker
upgrade appears and disappears with room membership. No PostCombat callback
is exercised by these Bumps.

Two muted Instant native processes produced equal complete archive roots and
preserved original files. The model matches every train/context and gameplay
RNG successor, with eight immutable branches per row. An altered enemy name
is accepted by the structural rule; missing masks, preview, unknown source,
changed room identity and moon callbacks remain rejected. The 9,948-byte
binary has 1,152 unique nodes and SHA-256
`2ced40bd345c7fd70d31391c6142a54e1751f6aec901731ab9bb2761ce6747de`.
Natural EndTurn ascension remains separate.

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Run-FullBattleProbe.ps1 -RoomMoonInactiveMushyMovement -GameSpeed Instant
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Check-Models.ps1 -Fixture room-moon-inactive-mushy-movement-calibration.mt2f
```
